description: On-chain leases (SPEC.md §31, Leases), made with fixed random bytes (NIP-44 nonces, BIP-340 auxiliary data) for the sale of vectors/app/app.json's declaration (its sale key, secret and author, taker tag) in its business's registry (`registryKey`, `registryReader`). `derived`: the registry address of each address, and the outer key of the sale's records there. `events`: records as relays send them; `outside` is what anyone holding the registry key opens (null: it does not open), `inside` what the sale (inner key: the sale secret and the registry reader) and the merchant open (null: none, or invalid), and `tolerance` the order's tolerance it gives (SPEC.md §31, The merchant's tolerance; absent: 0). The first lease's invoice is vectors/app/app.json's real invoice (21 sats: opening a lease does not check the on-chain floor). `confirmed`: whether a lease the sale opens is confirmed (SPEC.md §31, Leases: `confirmed` true; absent from this field: true). `signature`: false when the event's signature does not check out (absent: it does); opening it at a lease's place does not check it (SPEC.md §31, Opening a lease). `leased`: whether an address is leased at time `t`, from its records at its registry address (each its `author`, `createdAt`, `outside`; `signature` false when its signature does not check out, `id` false when its id is not its hash, `eventId` its id when two of an author share a second), and `checked`: the records whose signature the walk of every author checks (indices; one that stops at the first author holding the address checks fewer). `confirmed` (the cases): whether the lease `lease` (an index; null: it is not among the records read) of the sale `sale` is confirmed (SPEC.md §31, Leasing an address, step 3.3) at `t` by a read of the address's leases, `complete` or not.
